title: UL-10 — Challenge: Queue and event path
scenario: Add DLQ and idempotent Lambda handling to the messaging lab.
acceptanceCriteria: Name the resources you create `workbook-ul10`: function `workbook-ul10`, role `workbook-ul10-lambda`, queues `workbook-ul10` and `workbook-ul10-dlq`, topic `workbook-ul10`, and table `workbook-ul10-idem` if you use DynamoDB for idempotency. Tag each one LabId=ul-10.
Primary SQS queue and dead-letter queue pair configured with redrive policy.
Lambda processes messages idempotently (duplicate delivery does not double side effects).
Failed messages land in DLQ after maxReceiveCount.
You send one bad message and observe DLQ depth increase.
CloudWatch log group for Lambda exists during test.
SNS topic fans out to queue and/or Lambda as designed.
IAM roles least privilege per service.
Teardown deletes event source mappings first.
Teardown deletes Lambda then log group.
DLQ is empty or deleted with queue.

hints.text: Use partial batch responses for SQS triggers.
Idempotency key in DynamoDB or conditional write.

stopChargesPanel: Delete event source mappings, the Lambda function and its log group, the main queue and DLQ, the SNS topic, the idempotency table if any, then the IAM role for ul-10.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Lost an ID? aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-10

foreach ($Uuid in (aws lambda list-event-source-mappings --function-name workbook-ul10 --query "EventSourceMappings[].[UUID]" --output text)) { if ($Uuid) { aws lambda delete-event-source-mapping --uuid $Uuid } }
$QueueUrl = aws sqs get-queue-url --queue-name workbook-ul10 --query QueueUrl --output text
$DlqUrl = aws sqs get-queue-url --queue-name workbook-ul10-dlq --query QueueUrl --output text
# delete-topic also removes the topic's subscriptions

foreach ($P in (aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul10-lambda --query "AttachedPolicies[].[PolicyArn]" --output text)) { if ($P) { aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul10-lambda --policy-arn $P } }

foreach ($P in ((aws iam list-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul10-lambda --query PolicyNames --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($P -and $P -ne 'None') { aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul10-lambda --policy-name $P } }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-10 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws lambda get-function --function-name workbook-ul10 returns ResourceNotFoundException
aws sqs get-queue-url --queue-name workbook-ul10-dlq returns QueueDoesNotExist
aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-ul10-lambda returns NoSuchEntity
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-10 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-10. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-10) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
